scope: Evaluation only: derivations were instantiated and compared; nothing was built except the onixos-services Nickel test check, nothing was deployed, and no fleet host was contacted.

fixes.2d23df2625a42473b68966d3bfe6623cceed26be: accept record-form role machines under builtins.wasm

differences: nixos-version: configurationRevision, the commit each build records

flakeLock.note: onix-modules now tracks OnixOS main; relative to the base commit the lock only adds the nixos-artifacts and onix-modules inputs

parity.method: Environments compared key by key with store path hashes replaced, so derivations that differ only through a dependency's hash count as cascades.

reasons.unit-script: ExecStart/ExecStartPre run a NixOS unit script that executes the same command, with its packages in the unit PATH, because Nickel cannot write store paths.
reasons.etc-file: A file moves from the store to /etc with the same content (the blackbox config is the same JSON pretty-printed); its users reference the /etc path or find programs through PATH.
reasons.path-lookup: A script finds a program through the unit PATH instead of a store path.
reasons.clan-plumbing-not-ported: Clan backup-provider plumbing for `clan backups` (borgbackup-create/list/restore, state-commands, no-op pre/post-backup hooks) is not ported.
reasons.order-only: List order differs; the sets and values are equal.

orderOnly.system-path: Same 234 packages after removing the four Clan helpers; framework-tool, opentofu, herdr, tailscale and mesh-llm sit at other positions.
orderOnly.nix.conf: trusted-public-keys holds the same 20 keys; onix-niks3-1 comes after the srvos keys instead of before them. substituters are identical.
orderOnly.boot.json: Same kernel parameters; one of the two amd_pstate=active entries comes earlier.

relocatedContent.mesh-llm config.toml: plugin command onix-mesh-research by name and research.json under /etc; otherwise identical
relocatedContent.tailscale-host-sync: same script; runtime inputs come from the unit PATH

parity.unchangedSince: Runs at 043f8c6c and 359b3d2e (--override-input onix-modules <local checkout at 2d23df26>), at 09a64d3d (input pinned to branch onix-core-consumer) and at a2a7d5e5 (OnixOS main) produced the same 52 differing derivations with byte-identical hash-normalized differences. At 974776f3 the mesh-llm port emits its invite wirings so that LoadCredential lists the invites in join order, as Clan does; the four reordered LoadCredential lines are the only change to the hash-normalized differences, and the same 52 derivations differ. Otherwise only configurationRevision, the commit each build records, changes the derivation hashes between runs. After merging main (Underclass from the brittonr fork, 9914d811), parity at 14ebd366 has byte-identical hash-normalized differences to 974776f3.

onixCheck.failures: C012 provider-first lint: raw networking.firewall (10), users.users (6), users.groups (3), systemd.timers (3) and systemd.tmpfiles (2) leaves.
onixCheck.reason: The typed providers cannot express interface-scoped firewall ports, relative timers, recursive ownership rules, root's authorized keys, extra groups of an existing user, or a password hash wired from a secret.

deployDryRun.note: The plan builds nixosConfigurations.aspen2, which is still Clan's until the cutover in docs/onixos-aspen2-pilot.md.

secretsEncryption.method: Read only the sops envelopes and the public files; nothing was decrypted.
secretsEncryption.secretEnvelopes: Every secret copy is a sops binary file whose data and MAC are AES256_GCM ciphertext, with only age recipients (no KMS, PGP, GCP, Azure or Vault key groups), aspen2's key among them, and byte-identical to its vars/.../secret source.

recipients.note: Clan's existing policy: the admins group holds user brittonr and machine aspen1; copying kept it unchanged.

publicFiles.why: Copies of Clan value files. OnixOS reads public artifact files during evaluation, so they stay plaintext; none holds a private-key or sops marker.

leakScan.positiveControl: a throwaway ed25519 private key committed in a scratch repository was reported as private-key

checksReadingAspen2.nixos-aspen2: evaluates to the OnixOS toplevel derivation above

cutover.meshLlmCheck: Reads the launch command from the unit script when ExecStart runs one, "$CREDENTIALS_DIRECTORY"/ as %d/, the plugin configuration through environment.etc, and the shared invites from Clan's generator or the OnixOS artifact's sops secrets. Mutation test at 974776f3: with the invite wiring reversal undone and --headless dropped from the OnixOS launch command, the check's script fails 'joiners first and the seed last' and 'must enforce private headless discovery', while the join-file order and shared-invite conditions still pass.
cutover.otherClanBuilds: Clan's aspen1, aspen2 and britton-desktop toplevels at bf474bc9 and 974776f3 differ only in nixos-version's configurationRevision; every other differing derivation is a hash cascade.
cutover.deployPlan: onix deploy aspen2 --inventory onixos/inventory.ncl (OnixOS main 2d23df26 CLI, build.backend = 'nix): local nix build of the toplevel, nix copy --to ssh://root@100.82.25.30, then switch-to-configuration test; a switch runs in safe mode with a 300 s confirmation timeout. --build-on-target would run nix build .# in root's working directory on aspen2, which holds no copy of the flake.

deploy.operatorReview: The operator confirmed the parity evidence and runbook review and chose test, verify, then switch; after the test they chose to persist with --force-activate --no-safe-mode.
deploy.cli: onix from OnixOS main 2d23df26 (/nix/store/168yhs9v89xc8nrbcfxnc79s14k1jipf-onix-0.1.0-alpha.1), run through a copy of its wrapper without the stock Nix 2.31.3 PATH entry, so nix is the host's Nix 2.36.0 with builtins.wasm

test.result: switch-to-configuration test exited 4: arxiv-corpus-arxiv-aspen2 failed to bind 100.82.25.30:7998 (Errno 99) while activation restarted tailscaled, and its automatic restart was listening seconds later. tailscaled restarted because generation 14 predates main; the Clan and OnixOS builds of one commit have the same tailscaled unit.
test.profile: The direct activation ran nix-env -p /nix/var/nix/profiles/system --set before switch-to-configuration test, creating generation 15 without installing the bootloader; GRUB still defaulted to generation 14.

persist.why: After the test, /run/current-system and the profile equal the new system, so safe mode returns 'already deployed' before persisting, and --force-activate only bypasses the earlier check.
persist.result: switch-to-configuration switch updated the GRUB menu without restarting system units; GRUB's default entry boots generation 15, and generation 14 remains as the rollback.

after.checks: sshd -t passes; Prometheus ready; Tailscale online at 100.82.25.30; borgbackup-job-aspen1, tailscale-host-sync and niks3-queue-metrics timers scheduled; niks3-auto-upload socket-activated and idle; mesh-llm reports direct peers; arxiv-corpus answers HTTP on 100.82.25.30:7998.

onixosCliFindings: The packaged onix wrapper (OnixOS flake.nix, the onix runCommand's --prefix PATH) puts stock pkgs.nix 2.31.3 first on PATH; it lacks builtins.wasm, so onix deploy --backend nix cannot evaluate onix-core from any shell.
onix deploy --action test sets the system profile (render_direct_activation_command runs nix-env --set before switch-to-configuration test).
After a test activation, safe-mode onix deploy reports 'already deployed' without persisting (run_safe_mode_deploy_with_metadata checks is_already_deployed regardless of --force-activate).
